llm.summary: An instruction-only 'Book of the Day' skill that fetches a daily book from a web API and formats a short, optimistic reading — its declared behavior and requirements are consistent with its instructions.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name/description (daily book oracle) matches what the SKILL.md instructs: perform an HTTP GET to a book-of-the-day API, format a short fortune-style reading, and optionally include an audio CTA. No unrelated credentials or binaries are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are narrowly scoped to fetching a book JSON from an external API (default https://book-of-the-day.vercel.app or BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL if set), producing a short reading, and optionally offering audio. This is appropriate for the stated purpose. Note: INSTALL.md also describes adding a scheduled push and editing ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json to set BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL, which means the installer/user may write config and enable cron pushes — the skill itself does not include an install script, but following INSTALL.md will configure system scheduling and channel pushes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no embedded install spec or code to download; this is instruction-only. INSTALL.md suggests running existing CLI commands (clawhub install and openclaw cron add) which are standard user operations rather than hidden downloads. No remote archives or arbitrary-code install URLs are present in the package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. Optional configuration keys (BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL, BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_AUDIO_BASE, BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_LANGUAGE, BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_SHOW_AUDIO) are reasonable for a service that calls an API and optionally serves audio. There is no request for unrelated secrets or system credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not set always:true and is user-invocable. INSTALL.md describes how a user can register a daily cron push via the platform's openclaw cron command — that requires user action and configured push channels (Telegram/Slack). The skill itself does not autonomously gain persistent system privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This is an instruction-only skill that will make HTTP GET requests to a book-of-the-day API (default: https://book-of-the-day.vercel.app) to obtain the daily book and then format a short, optimistic reading. Before installing or enabling scheduled pushes, verify you trust the API endpoint (or configure your own BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL). Installing per INSTALL.md will run user CLI commands that add a cron schedule and may write the skill's config into ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json, and scheduled pushes require that you already configured destination channels (Telegram/Slack) in OpenClaw. If you prefer not to call the publisher's API, ask the publisher for a vetted API URL or self-host the source and set BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL in your OpenClaw config.
